mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reminders (user_id, content, event_at, timezone, status, source_message_id, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, #{eventAt}, #{timezone}, #{status}, #{sourceMessageId}, 1, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (source_message_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM reminders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'DELIVERED') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM reminders WHERE source_message_id = #{sourceMessageId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM reminders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DELIVERED', 'ACKNOWLEDGED') ORDER BY id DESC
